notes.title: Sungame Studio is releasing a new horror game soon!
notes.content:
Dear RFMIYC players,

We at Sungame Studio are glad to announce that we will be releasing a new horror game, Submarine Terror, on April 25th, 2024.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2409250/Submarine_Terror/

[b]Story : [/b]

Several months ago, a sinister shadow claimed the lives of two military submarines, vanishing them into the unfathomable depths of the Atlantic Ocean. Suspicions run deep, pointing to an aquatic entity of unparalleled terror.

Your mission: descend to the perilous abyss in a diminutive submarine and extract knowledge about this nameless creature without becoming its next victim.


[b]Features:[/b]

[list][*]Non-Linear: Navigate the abyss on your terms as you seek to uncover the truth while battling primal fear. Every choice you make shapes your destiny.
[*]Multiple Endings: Your path will dictate your fate. Will you emerge alive with revelations, or will the abyss swallow you whole?
[*]Open-World: Immerse yourself in the unforgiving depths of the Atlantic Ocean, a realm where the line between survival and despair is razor-thin.[/list]

Wishlist now!

Peace.

Julia at Sungame Studio.

notes.title: V6.0 - Big update
notes.content:
What is added in this patch :

New features :
- You can now play with a gamepad.
- You can randomize your path without having to restart the game.
- You can find in the setting menu the number of the new path that was assigned to you.
- A link to the soundtrack was added.
- The ending scene has been changed.

Modifications:
- The monster doesn't keep following the player after death.
- One safe zone was not working properly, it's now fixed.
- Improved monster patrol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471092/1d6f8c8435e6409559f3bbb6223a33320f12c9b2.png[/img]

notes.title: V5.0 - Big update
notes.content:
[b]What is added in this patch :[/b]
[b]
New features :[/b]
- 3 achievements were added("Find the secret path", "Activate the hidden bridge" and "Find your computer").
- Functional ladders were added.
- You can now re-randomize your path in the setting menu.
- One new path was added.

[b]Modifications :[/b]
- You can stay longer in the same place before the camera shakes.
- Some paths have changed.
- An easier mechanic system to activate the hidden bridge in the end.
- Better monster spawn location.
- Cured the "heart arrhythmia" problem of Sarah (No more double heart beat).
- The secret path has changed.
- Fixed bugged textures.
- More safe zones and more batteries.
